citations.claim: cart exits track at first violating step
one step before, cart still inside but moving outward at ~-1.35 m/s
cart already far off-center mid-run while pole stays balanced

counterfactual.change: Set initial.x from -0.4546 to 0.0 only; same 140 steps. Cart no longer starts off-center with outward velocity so the slow drift does not reach the track end and no rule is violated.

explanation: The state-feedback controller regulates pole angle (theta stays ~-0.05 to -0.08 rad, margin ~0.72) but applies only weak cart-correcting force (~0.26-0.58 N vs 45.6 N limit). Starting off-center (x=-0.45) with outward velocity (v=-0.24 m/s), the cart drifts monotonically negative (x=-1.09 at step 70, -1.53 at step 100, -2.38 at step 139) until it exits the track at step 140 (x=-2.40). Cause is insufficient cart-position authority/weighting in the balancing controller, not a disturbance (no pushes, no noise).

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart sits at the far left edge of the track while the pole stays nearly upright with the orange tip on top. From step 137 to 140 the cart creeps further left past the track limit with no visible falling of the pole.
